d:
Official music video for original single "Make a Move" by Vidya Vox.
Hey guys! I'm so excited to share it with you as I directed this video, exploring a new side of myself and artistry. Often, female sensuality is viewed through and for the male gaze. However, I wanted to explore it on my terms, through my eyes, through my music and dance. I felt powerful directing and performing this truly for myself and now, I'm letting you into my world. I hope you enjoy it!
